build: LT02: the plain Modwerk Rytm base (modwerk-base-analog-rytm-mkii-1c14b6b0) plus this module, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs with m68k-linux-gnu-gcc; full image remains private.
setup: Cold boot of build LT02 on a fresh card image; four held NO presses clear the calibration notices. DTBOOT_STEPS=1; DTBOOT_PNG_DIR points outside Git. Screen documentation only.
